cs.t:
Funny, I've just started working on adding OCPP support to the SmartEVSE v3 platform. If you want a capable DIY solution, I recommend the SmartEVSE (v3) platform. The hardware is quite capable (ESP32 based, support for switching between 1 & 3 phase charging).
The software requires some more work to fully utilize the hardware, but is open source. No cloud APIs required :) Code & schematics:  https://github.com/SmartEVSE/SmartEVSE-3
cs.th: Build your own EV charging solution
